title: SwarmEvolve Tactic Detector Event (M18, schema 2)
description: One JSON Lines record emitted by scripts/tactic_detector.py to `tactic_events.jsonl`. Each record is a first-appearance event for a named tactic (flanking, kiting, focus_fire, message_coded_targeting). All thresholds are frozen in scripts/tactic_detector.py — any change bumps `schema_version`. See NEXT_PHASE_PLAN.md §M18 for the detector semantics.

schema_version.description: Tactic-event schema version. 1 = M18; 2 = after the v2 calibration (see scripts/tactic_detector.py).

first_tick.description: Tick at which the qualifying condition first held (tick 0 is never used: it is the spawn). flanking / kiting = start of the qualifying streak; focus_fire = first tick with a focused hit; message_coded_targeting = first tick with an alive-drone target observation.

sustained_ticks.description: Duration metric associated with the event. flanking / kiting: the streak threshold reached. focus_fire: the number of hits. message_coded_targeting: the number of observation ticks.

track.description: Experimental track (e.g. A/B/C) or empty string when running ad-hoc.

model.description: Model identifier that authored the AI under review.

generation.description: Generation index within the lineage; -1 when unspecified.

perspective.description: Which team we scored the detector from.

evidence.description: Detector-specific payload; every detector includes its thresholds. flanking -> {angle_deg, cluster_sizes, spread_ratio, max_range, threshold_*}; kiting -> {kiting_fraction, max_kiting_fraction, threshold_fraction, threshold_streak_ticks, cos_min}; focus_fire -> {focused_share, hits, focused_hits, threshold_focused_share, threshold_min_hits}; message_coded_targeting -> {best_channel, nmi, null_quantile, target_events, observation_ticks, threshold_nmi}.
